g.text: The old post is drawn ghosted so the retrofit parts, pads and fasteners behind and inside it stay visible. Orange = parts you print now (R1), pale orange = tape.
R1 needs no cutting and no inserts. R2 is an option: one jigsaw cut, a new head, 4 inserts and 4 screws. Concept render from the current CAD.
dock post (as built), printed earlier, unchanged (drawn ghosted so the parts behind it show)
2x tape strip 23.6 x 14.8 x 0.4, column to dock foot
2x tape disc D10 x 0.4, stop pad to wall face
parked tool, for scale (FR1, neck in the slot)
option R2 head (design only, not printed or fit-tested; new slot: land 8, 1.0 mm/side, 4 mm lead-in chamfers)
4x M3 heat-set insert, 5.0 OD x 4 L, into the stump face (y = +-45, +-53, z = -33)
4x M3x10 button-head screw, head flange to stump
jigsaw cut: one straight cut at z = -24 removes the old wall top (R2 only)
Tape and the R2 fasteners are drawn here; the dock table frame and clamp bars are parts 40-44 on the exploded drawing. Sizes nominal. Part details: docs/BOM.md. CERN-OHL-W-2.0.
